comments.author: MatrixAwpington
comments.body_html:
honestly, I think I ghost removed that at some point

if you want to add it back

go to the src folder and open up mod.ts

step 1,

at line 182 where it says

const GRECHKA = “6389c6463485cf0eeb260715”;

add this following line underneath it

const HOLODILNICK = “5c093db286f7740a1b2617e3”;

step 2,

underneath all of those const declarations you should see a return block that contains the line

“Filter”: [COFFEE, LUPO, TEA, FOOD, GRECHKA],

turn it into this

“Filter”: [COFFEE, LUPO, TEA, FOOD, GRECHKA, HOLODILNICK],
